en: The front image shows a broad, multi-lane boulevard bordered by trees and decorative flower beds, with classic mid-century vehicles and a trolleybus. The road runs along a green park area adjacent to a large body of water, likely the sea, with a beach and coastal facilities visible in the distance. The overall landscape is lush and indicative of a resort zone. The reverse side contains multilingual descriptions in Bulgarian, Russian, English, Italian, and German, referencing 'Zlatni Pyasatsi' (Golden Sands) and the 'Varna-Golden Sands motorway.' There are also publication and pricing details.
